title: NMRを用いた食品中の食品添加物分析法の開発に関する研究
institution: 国立医薬品食品衛生研究所
sample_preparation: General standard preparation: approximately 10 mg analyte in approximately 1.0 g qNMR standard solution or deuterated solvent. Exact concentration for Fig. 1 not separately stated.
digitization: Chemical shifts transcribed from explicit structural labels in Fig. 1, not estimated from pixels. Only peak positions used; raw trace, widths, intensities, multiplets and coupling constants are not digitized.
numbering: Project numbering starts at methyl C1 and ends at carboxyl C6; opposite to IUPAC acid numbering. H9-H11 on C1; H12-H15 on C2-C5; H16 is OH. Dimer second fragment uses +16.
